name: Financial Tool Kit
description: A ledger-styled personal-finance toolkit (formerly Mortgage Tool Kit). Radial hub of six tool areas, each with its own calculators: Mortgage (escrow, amortization, PITI, affordability, refinance, compare, ARM, rent-vs-buy, T-Note), Auto (loan, lease-vs-buy, TCO, refi, payoff), Investing (compound growth, CAGR, DCA, dividends, allocation), Budgeting & Savings (50/30/20, savings goal, emergency fund, net worth, paycheck), Credit & Debt (snowball/avalanche payoff, card/loan payoff, consolidation, utilization), and Retirement & Taxes (401k/IRA growth, readiness, drawdown, federal tax, RMD). Every area shows a forced 'information only, not advice' disclaimer.
